dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible smooth, linear 2D narrowing of the dorsal mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate-grey to medium-grey baseline skin tone across the exposed dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the central and left-lateral dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the slate-grey baseline and localized darker pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear, high-contrast light marks (scratches or rake marks) visible on the right lateral side of the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of fine, linear superficial scarring oriented longitudinally and diagonally along the right-side dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined, elevated longitudinal dorsal ridge running along the center of the visible mass.
